h: NCDC approves N100,000 weekly payments for people under Ebola monitoring
p: The Nigeria Centre for Disease Control has reportedly approved a weekly stipend of N100,000 for people being monitored as contacts of the confirmed Ebola case. The payment is said to be meant to help them stay at home for the monitoring period.
more: Health officials are still tracing contacts of the confirmed case in Abuja.
Neighbouring countries have tightened travel rules as the outbreak is watched.
